reason: The user requested that the worker remain available until completion. Preserve completed component and final-dataset artifacts across replacement workers, and leave a failed worker reachable for recovery instead of terminating immediately.
failure_behavior: On a recoverable pipeline error, sync artifacts and worker-state.json, exit the failed pipeline, and leave the instance running for SSM recovery. Successful completion still terminates the instance. An independent systemd timer still shuts it down at the approved cumulative-budget deadline.
resume_behavior: Reuse registered staging, frozen-model on-policy, and independently audited final-dataset artifacts from the experiment S3 prefix when their manifests exist.
scope: Operations-only resilience. Research design, dataset identity, model, eligible endpoint, evaluation cohorts, gates, and final-test seal are unchanged.
